summary: Cohen & Co Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its operating subsidiary owns a portion of and serves as managing member of the sponsor of Columbus Circle Capital Corp. II (CMIIU), a SPAC that on June 26, 2026 entered into a definitive business combination agreement with Elroy Air, Inc. Under the agreement, a merger sub will merge with Elroy Air, making it a wholly owned subsidiary of the SPAC. Cohen Company Capital Markets (CCM), a division of Cohen's broker-dealer subsidiary, acted as lead underwriter for the SPAC's IPO and is joint financial advisor and co-placement agent for this business combination. The transaction is subject to shareholder approvals and customary conditions. Watch for shareholder vote timing and potential redemptions.
